boundary: Schematic figure; only PDF, SVG and PNG are provided. No analysis code or figure-specific data.

title: Benchmarking framework
boundary: Schematic figure; only PDF, SVG and PNG are provided. No analysis code or figure-specific data.

title: Evaluation on simulated and conventional datasets
boundary: 740 pairs in the main figure and 698 in Extended Data. Per-dataset maxima are a post hoc envelope.

title: ReDeeM
boundary: 21 configurations with saved GDC/CBDir. Nine recovered scatter canvases support the enlarged markers; shared-canvas mappings and remaining historical field limitations are documented.

title: Spatial and lineage-referenced evaluation
boundary: ST_small spatial comparison includes archived TopoVelo. KPTracer PhyloVelo is shown backward; forward-adapted GDC is diagnostic only and excluded from comparable rankings.

title: Runtime, read-depth sensitivity, frozen composite and VeloGIF
boundary: Panels a/b now contain runtime/read-depth sensitivity; c is the unchanged frozen composite (0.6 accuracy rank + 0.4 scalability rank; stability excluded); d is VeloGIF. Matched-protocol limitations remain.

title: Age-related examples and future directions
boundary: The exact 784-gene list and matching run have not been recovered; this does not establish validated age-related dynamics.

title: Method taxonomy and dyngen simulation design
boundary: 14 topologies and 42 seeded datasets; the former ED2 has been incorporated.

title: cellDancer simulation design
boundary: Three scenarios and 30 datasets; continuous U/S values are not observed integer counts.

title: Overview of real-world datasets
boundary: 10 conventional datasets and metadata for 176 HuBMAP datasets; example embeddings are historical artwork.

title: Simulation cosine comparisons and full noise series
boundary: Noise panel c contains 840 slots (822 finite, 18 missing), with 84 cross-noise means. STT forward branching has 1/10 coverage; other groups have 10/10. Conditions are not independent replicates.

title: High- and low-dimensional comparisons
boundary: 698 paired dataset-by-method values; means and sample SDs were recomputed by topology.

title: GDC on real-world datasets
boundary: Aligned with the main-figure source values; 18 HuBMAP configurations, with no valid TopicVelo value for this task.

title: scNT metabolic-labeling reference
boundary: 1,947 reference cells and 19 configurations; projected cosines were recomputed per cell. Preprocessing differs across pipelines.

title: scLT lineage reference
boundary: 1,756 reference cells and 19 configurations; original membership and random-selection records for the five clone examples are incomplete.

title: ST_raw spatial evaluation
boundary: 1,292 spots and five reference relationships. Archived TopoVelo is included with a 608-cell reference denominator; its training configuration is unavailable.

title: Paired consistency across spatial contexts
boundary: 20 methods x 608 paired spots after adding TopoVelo. TopoVelo has 47 shared genes and 606 valid pairs; two undefined pairs remain missing. VeloAE gene-space scores remain unavailable.

title: KPTracer and PhyloVelo direction audit
boundary: 754 cells and 706 reference cells. PhyloVelo uses native backward vectors for display and their negative for metrics. A repeated global gene vector makes ICCoh structurally one: adapted GDC +1 is not a comparable rank.

title: Metascape and historical age-related examples
boundary: Nine configurations with 519/809 mapped genes in top100/top200 lists, respectively. Enrichment reports were imported; age-example provenance gaps remain explicit.
